cohort: The study included 1038 deliveries from 2021 to 2023 in a single institution.
finding: Assisted reproductive technology, nulliparity, and congenital uterine anomalies were identified as independent risk factors for marginal cord insertion (MCI), which in turn was an independent risk factor for fetal growth restriction (FGR) and emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was significantly more prevalent in cases with marginal cord insertion (MCI).
